item.title: U.S. Treasury proposes GENIUS Act rules requiring stablecoin issuers to hold 1:1 reserves; mandatory licensing begins Jan. 18, 2027
Goldman Sachs to acquire Neos Investments for up to $2.25B, gaining three Bitcoin and Ether income ETFs with over $1.2B in AUM
U.S. spot Ether ETFs record $2.85B in weekly net inflows, more than five times the $548M recorded by spot Bitcoin ETFs in the same period
Coldcard hardware wallet exploit drains $116M in Bitcoin from over 5,200 addresses via a five-year-old firmware flaw; total 2026 crypto losses top $1.2B
Circle receives federal trust bank charter, granting the USDC issuer regulated federal banking status
Morgan Stanley receives conditional OCC approval for Morgan Stanley Digital Trust to custody digital assets, facilitate staking, and execute transfers
SEC approves T. Rowe Price TKNZ, the first actively managed multi-asset crypto ETF from a $1.9T traditional asset manager, to trade on NYSE Arca
Coinbase, Visa, and Mastercard launch Open Standard stablecoin network with Open USD, backed by more than 140 financial and technology firms
Moscow Exchange launches perpetual Bitcoin and Ether futures for qualified investors, with Solana, XRP, and TRON contracts planned
SEC classifies 16 digital assets as commodities, clearing the way for spot ETF filings on SOL, XRP, ADA, LINK, AVAX, DOGE, and others
SEC and CFTC sign memorandum of understanding and issue joint interpretation clarifying how federal securities law applies to crypto assets
CFTC approves first cash-settled Bitcoin perpetual futures contracts on a registered U.S. designated contract market
Bank of America authorizes wealth advisers to recommend crypto allocations to clients as institutional digital asset adoption accelerates
EU MiCA grandfathering period ends; all crypto asset service providers must now operate under full Markets in Crypto-Assets regulatory framework
